subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new public per-agent-model generation timeout surface, or keep operators on existing provider/run timeout surfaces plus narrower thinking and repetition fixes?
rationale: This would add a new compatibility-sensitive config/default surface and fallback behavior, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs.

options.title: Define per-model generation timeout
options.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model budget with explicit precedence, fallback handling, docs/schema coverage, and focused runtime tests.

options.title: Use existing timeout surfaces
options.body: Decline a new key and improve docs around provider timeout, run timeout, first-event timeout, and idle watchdog behavior.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Keep generation timeout out of scope and route thinking stalls or repeated-output loops to their narrower canonical issues and fixes.

recommendation.title: Define per-model generation timeout
recommendation.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model budget with explicit precedence, fallback handling, docs/schema coverage, and focused runtime tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already mapped the remaining config decision and is the strongest current routing candidate from issue discussion plus timeout/config history.
